title: Two-stage Residual Learning for Modelling Strength-Informed Optimisation of Thermal Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.19539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aggregate performance metrics do not identify local modelling inaccuracies in machine learning (ML) surrogates used for thermal-system optimisation. This study assesses local modelling strength through validation-based reliability screening and post-optimisation residual assessment. A two-stage residual learning (TSRL) framework, built on artificial neural networks (ANNs), is developed for modelling-strength-informed and domain-constrained optimisation of thermal systems. Within the TSRL framework, a base ANN predicts the process output, and a residual ANN learns the signed residuals left by the base ANN. The TSRL framework is implemented on two case studies of thermal systems, including 817 simulation observations of a crude distillation unit and operating records from a 395 MW industrial gas turbine. translated_title: 两阶段残差学习用于建模强度感知的热力系统优化
translated_abstract: 总体性能指标无法识别用于热力系统优化的机器学习（ML）代理模型中的局部建模不准确问题。本研究通过基于验证的可靠性筛选和优化后残差评估来评估局部建模强度。研究开发了一种基于人工神经网络（ANN）的两阶段残差学习（TSRL）框架，用于建模强度感知且受领域约束的热力系统优化。在TSRL框架中，一个基础神经网络预测过程输出，另一个残差神经网络学习基础神经网络留下的带符号残差。TSRL框架在两个热力系统案例研究中得到实现，包括原油蒸馏装置的817个模拟观测数据和一台395 MW工业燃气轮机的运行记录。TSRL框架将炼油数据集中燃料油的测试均方根误差（RMSE）从10.3 g/s降低到4.7 g/s，并将……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于人工神经网络的两阶段残差学习（TSRL）框架，通过基础神经网络与残差神经网络的级联建模，结合局部建模强度评估与领域约束，显著降低了热力系统代理模型的预测误差，实现了更可靠的热力系统优化。
en_tdlr: A two-stage residual learning (TSRL) framework is proposed, in which a base ANN and a residual ANN work in cascade with reliability screening and domain constraints, substantially reducing surrogate prediction errors for modelling-strength-informed optimisation of thermal systems.
